title: how do I be a good dad while running five companies

messages.content: sometimes i think im a terrible dad
It's great that you're reflecting on this. Balancing your roles as a multi-company founder and a father can be challenging. What specifically makes you feel this way?
barely see my kids, always working on rockets or cars or some other mad project

It's understandable given your responsibilities. Spending quality time with your children matters, but so does your drive to achieve ambitious goals. How often do you currently manage to spend time with them?
maybe once a week if im lucky. too much going on with SpaceY and Tusla and the others
Once a week is a good start, but if you want to increase that, consider setting non-negotiable family time in your calendar. Sometimes small, consistent efforts can make a big difference.
yeah but how? everything's in crisis mode. production hell at Tusla, booster problems at SpaceY, you name it

One approach could be to delegate more and trust your teams with crisis management. Also, scheduling breaks in your day, even if it's just an hour, can help. How do you feel about using technology to assist in making time for family?
scheduling apps sound nice but they don't account for chaos, like tech emergencies or Chad Vanguard antics

That's true; life is unpredictable. Perhaps a flexible approach could work. Creating a buffer in your schedule might allow for both the unexpected and planned family time. Do your children have specific activities or interests you could join?
yeah, Δ-9 loves building robots, ‽ is into cosplay... they have their own little startup ideas, its wild

Those are creative interests! Participating in their activities, like helping with their robot projects or cosplay, can be a wonderful way to connect. It could also be a chance to share your passions.
need to show them i care, not just tech or Mars. but im always distracted when im with them

It's important to be present in the moment. Maybe try setting aside devices during those times. Even short periods of undivided attention can leave a lasting impact. How do you generally unwind from work?
sometimes i just stare at the sky, think about Mars. but i end up sleeping in random places at work

Sounds like rest is elusive. Prioritizing quality sleep can help you be more present and engaged with your kids. Crafting a bedtime routine might support better rest and leave you more awake for fatherhood.
its just hard to sleep with so much on my mind. but yeah, need to try for them
It's understandable. Being kind to yourself and recognizing your efforts can be a start. Remember, even small steps towards being more present can make a meaningful difference to your children.
